name: Banana Wax

features.text: Very easy to rub off, even in direct sunlight.
Provides protection against surface contaminants and UV damage.

description: A high-gloss, easy-to-use cream wax. The advanced formula combines natural carnauba wax, polishing agents and resins to create a deep “wet-look” shine on painted surfaces. It fills in fine scratches and swirl marks, while providing a durable finish. Banana Wax ® is designed for use on all types of paints, including clearcoat, enamel, metallic, and lacquer.
application: By Hand: Using an applicator pad, apply product evenly to surface using an overlapping, circular motion. Allow product to dry to a haze. Remove residue with a clean, dry polishing cloth or microfiber towel. Orbital or DA Buffer: In small sections (2'x2'), apply product evenly to the surface with a moist polishing bonnet or foam pad in an overlapping pattern. Allow product to dry to a haze. Remove residue with a clean, dry bonnet or microfiber towel.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Abrasiveness - 2 Gloss - 8 Durability - 7
